# app-text-encoding

The legacy code pages a lyrics file can be read in, converted to UTF-8 by the operating system (MultiByteToWideChar, iconv) as the decoder libs/lyrics asks a program for. Internal; linked by forge and the Forge GUI.

A app library, internal to the repository.

- **Uses:** `lyrics`
- **Used by:** `forge`
- **CI lanes:** windows, linux, macos

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
ctest --preset test-linux-gcc -L app-text-encoding
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build; `ctest -L` runs this project's tests alone.
